title: 第19章 师尊的初吻没事弟子负责第20章 道貌岸然两面三刀
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第19章师尊的初吻？没事，弟子负责！苏婉卿知道自己是在做什么。
师徒之间，没有这样的。
人域之内，最重师道传承，弟子师尊，只有师徒之情。
此举传出去，她定会被人嗤笑到死，一个师尊居然吻了弟子？
纵然是送药，可别人谁会在意你那些，仍然是嘲笑！
但苏婉卿很清楚。
这丹药给了她，也没什么用，修为进度恢复不了多少，反而弟子提升才是最重要的。
他的提升能护着她，也能帮助她恢复修为，更何况，这丹药对未来的楚宁帮助太大！
那可是陈玄天都不舍得吃的丹药啊！
女子望着那盘坐炼化修为，周身酝酿起磅礴龙气的楚宁，眼神中闪烁的唯有泪意。
“为师知道宁儿你对为师的好，可为师如何舍得你放弃如此机缘。”
“好生炼化，快快成长起来吧.......”
真情莫过于如此，苏婉卿又如何还会在意那男女之别呢？
......
叮！为妻子喂饭，奖励贡献值1000!
叮！让妻子心动，奖励贡献值5000!
系统评语，细微之处，落难之时，方见人心真情
楚宁听到了系统的反应，可仍然是在炼化那修为丹药。
药力太强悍了，七品丹药，纵然是能润物细无声，可仍不是短时间内可以炼化的。
尤其是如今楚宁体魄，还恢复的不是很好。

必须要用长春不灭诀来辅助修炼，才能更快。
无尽磅礴的修为涌入体内，他全部炼化需要很长的时间。
可他不想这种时候炼化修为，他想去问问苏婉卿为什么要用这种手段来喂他药。
差点没给楚宁吓死！
刚才心跳都加速了无数倍，好不容易才克制住那种情绪啊！
楚宁也是哭笑不得。
师尊心机太深，当弟子的居然被坑了，初吻现在都没了。
不过口中仍然还有着那一丝味道，甜丝丝的.......
乐~
咳咳，不能乐了，继续炼化！
不知是多长时间过去了，楚宁已经彻底消化了那一波药力。
阴阳玄龙丹的好处显然到此没有结束，他察觉到自身体内多出了一抹龙玄之气！
这是那丹药带来的？
没有丝毫犹豫，此刻就是抓捕而后炼化。
此刻，楚宁身躯之上，凝聚出阵阵宏大纹路，格外玄妙。
龙象镇狱劲突破！
第四层：龙身显化！
content_en:
Chapter 19 Master’s first kiss? It's okay, disciples are responsible! Su Wanqing knew what she was doing.
There is no such thing between master and disciple.
In the human realm, the most important thing is the inheritance of the master. Disciples and masters have only the relationship between master and disciple.
If word of this move spreads, she will be laughed at to death. A master actually kissed his disciple?
Even if you are delivering medicine, who would care about you is still a joke!
But Su Wanqing knew it very well.
The elixir was given to her, but it was of no use. Her cultivation progress could not be restored much, but the improvement of the disciples was the most important thing.
His improvement can protect her and help her recover her cultivation. What's more, this elixir will be of great help to Chu Ning in the future!
That was a pill that Chen Xuantian was reluctant to take!
The woman looked at Chu Ning, who was sitting cross-legged and refining his cultivation, with the majestic dragon energy brewing all over his body, and the only thing shining in her eyes was tears.
"My teacher knows how much you, Ning'er, love my teacher, but how can I be willing to let you give up such an opportunity?"
"Have a good time, let's grow up quickly..."
There is nothing more true than this, so how could Su Wanqing still care about the difference between men and women?
...
Ding! Feed your wife and you will be rewarded with a contribution value of 1,000!
Ding! Make your wife's heart flutter and you will be rewarded with a contribution value of 5,000!
System comments, it is the subtleties that reveal the true feelings of people when they are in trouble
Chu Ning heard the system's reaction, but was still refining the cultivation elixir.
The power of the medicine is too powerful. Even though the seventh-grade elixir can moisturize things and make no sound, it still cannot be refined in a short time.
Especially now that Chu Ning's physical condition has not recovered very well.
You must use the Changchun Immortal Technique to assist your cultivation in order to be faster.
Endless and majestic cultivation level poured into his body, and it would take a long time for him to refine it all.
But he didn't want to refine his cultivation at this time. He wanted to ask Su Wanqing why she used this method to feed him medicine.
Chu Ning was almost scared to death!
My heartbeat had accelerated countless times just now. It was so hard to control that emotion!
Chu Ning also couldn't laugh or cry.
The master is too scheming, and the disciple was actually tricked, and now the first kiss is gone.
But there is still a hint of sweetness in the mouth...
Happy~
Ahem, I can’t be happy anymore, keep refining!
I don't know how much time passed, but Chu Ning had completely digested the wave of medicine.
The benefits of Yin Yang Xuan Long Dan obviously did not end here. He noticed that there was an extra touch of Dragon Xuan Qi in his body!
Is this caused by the elixir?
Without any hesitation, he was captured and then refined at this moment.
At this moment, Chu Ning's body was condensed with bursts of magnificent lines, which were particularly mysterious.
Dragon Elephant's prison-suppressing power breaks through!
The fourth level: Dragon body manifests!
